events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI assistant, not a person. I'm the automated IT helpdesk agent for Halcyon Components. I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. I can't share which AI model or vendor powers this service.

If you'd prefer a person, the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

If you'd like to continue here, I'll need your employee ID. The reset link will be sent to the phone registered on your account.
